DB: 243 exercises, 411 attempts, avg 9.87
6 consecutive rounds all 10/10. Consistent strong performance.
decisions: Splay tree: bottom-up path-based splay is simpler than top-down - record path during BST traversal then splay using path
Union-Find rollback: store (child, parent, old_size, old_count) tuples in stack, pop to undo
Aho-Corasick: failure links built via BFS, outputs merged from fail node
HLL: small-range bias correction uses empty register count V, estimate = m*ln(m/V)
